title: Choose method receiver ownership
summary: Construct a record, inspect it by shared borrow, edit it by exclusive borrow and finally consume it to return an owned field.

record.clue: Keyword defining the named-field record Label

selfType.clue: Type spelling referring to Label inside its implementation

shared.clue: Receiver that inspects Label without consuming or mutating it

view.clue: Borrowed UTF-8 slice return type for text

exclusive.clue: Receiver that permits changing the Label in place

append.clue: Method appending suffix to the owned field

consume.clue: Receiver that transfers ownership of Label into into_text

binding.clue: Modifier permitting label.append to borrow label exclusively

equal.clue: Macro comparing the consumed field with the expected owned text
